name: Alchemist's Crucible
effect: Modified items have a 10% chance to upgrade to the next modifier tier.
obtainment: Complete the Brewing Trouble quest for the Desert Alchemist.
modelNote: Modeled: +10% chance to upgrade to the next tier in the panning pool (boosts rare modifiers like Perfect).

name: Beach Umbrella
effect: Every modified item panned increases your base luck by 25 for the next pan.
obtainment: Purchased from the Blueprint & Trinket Vendor.
modelNote: Modeled at steady state: +25 × √Capacity × ModChance Base Luck (0 if Purity is active).

name: Duplicator
effect: Mythic and Exotic ores have a 10% chance to be duplicated.
obtainment: Repair the Broken Device behind the house (requires Crafting Mastery 5).
modelNote: Passive only: duplicates Mythic/Exotic drops (+10% quantity), does not change time to first drop.

name: Embalmer's Salt
effect: Grants +0.25% sell value per item panned (max +100%).
modelNote: Modeled at steady state at cap: +100% Sell Boost.

name: Golden Chalice
effect: Digging up a treasure map gives a +100% luck boost for 2 minutes.
obtainment: Dig at the red X in the Delta (requires Treasure Mastery 5).
modelNote: Passive only: temporary buff triggered by digging up a Treasure Map.

name: Mass Reactor
effect: Pans with more than 20 ores destroy the excess and give 25 base luck on the next pan per destroyed item.
obtainment: Complete the Going Nuclear quest for the Nuclear Scientist.
modelNote: Modeled at steady state: +25 × max(0, √Capacity − 20) Base Luck (also works with Purity).

name: Nomad's Compass
effect: Grants +15% luck for each deposit you filled 5 pans in this hour.
modelNote: Modeled on 1 active deposit: +15% Luck (scales in-game across multiple deposits per hour).

name: Senet Die
effect: Each full pan rolls a 6-sided die on final Luck: 1 -> ×0.5, 2 -> ×0.75, 3 -> ×1, 4 -> ×1.25, 5 -> ×1.5, 6 -> ×3 (mean ×4/3).
modelNote: Modeled as expected multiplier on final Luck: (0.5 + 0.75 + 1 + 1.25 + 1.5 + 3) / 6 = 4/3 (~1.3333x).

name: Tombstone
effect: Summons the Halloween Spirit to pan items for you and empowers the Pumpkin Set.
obtainment: Purchased next to the Pumpkin Pan & Shovel during the Halloween event.
modelNote: Passive only: special event effect / Pumpkin Set empowerment not quantified.
